filters.title: Member filters
filters.searchPlaceholder: Name, KTA number, REG-…, phone or e-mail

empty.title: No members yet
empty.description: Online registrations appear here. You can also add members or import field lists.

form.createDescription: New members start as pending until verified.
form.idNumberNone: None on file. Fill in to add one.
form.joinedAtHint: Blank: the verification date is used.
form.photoHint: JPG/PNG face photo (for the KTA card).

actions.approveDescription: {name} becomes a verified member and receives a KTA number.
actions.suspendDescription: {name} will be suspended and the KTA card stops verifying.
actions.reasonEmailed: The reason is e-mailed to the applicant.
actions.replacePhotoDescription: The new photo is used on the next KTA card. Re-issue the card to update it.
actions.deleteDescription: {name}'s record will be deleted and the KTA card revoked. This is recorded in the audit log.

profile.revealAudited: This action is recorded in the audit log

kta.notVerified: Only verified members can receive a KTA card.
kta.noCardHint: Issue the card to generate the PDF and PNG with QR code.

done.rotate_qr: QR code rotated — issue a new card

confirm.issueDescription: The current card is revoked and a new version is created with current data.
confirm.revokeDescription: The card will no longer verify when its QR code is scanned.
confirm.rotate_qrDescription: Use when a card is lost or stolen. All old QR codes stop verifying.
confirm.rotate_qrNext: Afterwards, issue a new card to the member.

import.title: Import members
import.description: Import field registration lists from CSV or Excel. Members are added as pending.
import.instructions: Use the template with the right columns. Validate first; nothing is imported until you confirm.
import.importedHint: New members are waiting for verification in the pending list.
import.partialHint: Only the {valid} valid rows will be imported. Fix the others and import them later.
import.allValidHint: All rows are valid. Ready to import.
import.noneValid: No valid rows. Fix the file and try again.
